[element-issue]
=== `<issue>` Issue Number (in a citation)

Within a citation (such as a <<element-mixed-citation,`<mixed-citation>`>> or an <<element-element-citation,`<element-citation>`>>), the issue number, issue name, or other identifier of an issue of a journal.

#### Attributes

* <<attribute-content-type,`@content-type`>>
* <<attribute-seq,`@seq`>>
* <<attribute-specific-use,`@specific-use`>>
#### Base Attributes

* <<attribute-id,`@id`>>
* <<attribute-xml-base,`@xml:base`>>
* <<attribute-xml-lang,`@xml:lang`>>

#### Models and Context

#### May be contained in

<<element-element-citation,`<element-citation>`>>, <<element-mixed-citation,`<mixed-citation>`>>, <<element-nlm-citation,`<nlm-citation>`>>, <<element-related-article,`<related-article>`>>, <<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>>
#### Description

Text, numbers, or special characters, zero or more
#### Content Model

[source,xml]
....
<!ELEMENT  issue        (#PCDATA %issue-elements;)*                  >
....
#### Expanded Content Model

(#PCDATA)*
